The hand-delivered `gdn_datafreeze_may2025/madagascar_clinic_data_cleaning.zip`
is the sole source of truth for the existing-wave migration. Its scientific
inputs and comparison outputs come exclusively from this ZIP. The separate
new-wave deliveries enter through [page 26](26_page-prep-2025-2026.qmd)'s
Stagecoach inventory and file branches. Both deliveries and maximum
reduction were authorized on 2026-11-08; this page still reads only the ZIP.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Staging Authority"}

On 2026-11-06 the researcher selected the ZIP supplied by hand as the fixed
input freeze and migration baseline. The previously staged Google Drive tree
is a periodically refreshed rclone mirror and can drift. It is excluded from
the pipeline, even when its files are newer. Existing Drive staging links may
remain on disk, but no existing-wave inventory scans or scientific readers
use them. The explicitly scoped new-wave branch remains separate from this inventory.

The Stagecoach manifest declares the hand-delivered ZIP for this migration
and two separate, narrowly scoped new-wave survey items for page 26. This
page's inventory still consumes only the ZIP. A later old-wave source freeze
requires an explicit, recorded change of archive and comparison baseline;
a sync or a newer filename does not change this contract.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Track The Authoritative Archive"}

The root `_targets.R` tangles these file targets into the initial graph.
The archive's contents are tracked directly; the manifest records staging
provenance. Rendering does not read scientific inputs or extract members.

```{r}
#| format: file
s0_pipeline_stagecoach_yml <- here::here("stagecoach_manifest.yml")
s0_pipeline_raw_zip <- {
  stopifnot(file.exists(s0_pipeline_stagecoach_yml))
  archive <- here::here(
    "data/inputs/01_gold_mine/gdn_datafreeze_may2025/madagascar_clinic_data_cleaning.zip"
  )
  if (!file.exists(archive)) stop("The hand-delivered May 2025 ZIP is not staged: ", archive)
  archive
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Select And Extract Reviewed Archive Inputs"}

Keep the existing path-based W3 and mapping readers, but supply them only with
unmodified source members extracted from the tracked ZIP. Select all W3 CSVs
and the exact reviewed mapping/identity sources. Other stages continue to
read their exact members directly from this same archive. The extracted
copies retain the original filenames and formats under
`data/intermediates/archive_sources/`; they are source copies, not new curated
products. They are tracked files and may be recreated from the ZIP.

Return only the members selected in this invocation, never a scan of the
extraction directory. Old extractions and Drive files cannot enter the graph.

```{r}
s0_pipeline_archive_members_fn <- function(archive) {
  members <- utils::unzip(archive, list = TRUE)$Name
  root <- "madagascar_clinic_data_cleaning/data/raw/"
  w3 <- members[startsWith(members, paste0(root, "from Symphonia/RMA_W3_FULL/")) &
                  endsWith(members, ".csv")]
  reviewed <- paste0(root, c(
    "from Symphonia/mapping GESIS DHIS questions - mapping DHIS2 GESIS 2010 2022.csv",
    "symphonia_verified/CSB1 CSB2 PUBLIC PRIVATE.xlsx",
    "symphonia_verified/gesis_missing_uid_in_mapping.xlsx",
    "symphonia_verified/VERIFIER fs_uid_year_with_multiple_gesis.csv",
    "symphonia_verified/VERIFIER clinic_codes_in_gesis_but_not_in_mapping.csv",
    "symphonia_verified/GESIS_snips_public_multipleLongGESIS VERIFIED.csv"
  ))
  if (!length(w3) || any(!reviewed %in% members)) {
    stop("The ZIP is missing required W3 or reviewed mapping/identity inputs.")
  }
  selected <- sort(c(w3, reviewed), method = "radix")
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(selected), all(vapply(selected, function(x) sum(members == x), 0L) == 1L),
            !any(grepl("^/|(^|/)\\.\\.(/|$)", selected)))
  selected
}

s0_pipeline_archive_inputs_fn <- function(archive, output_dir) {
  members <- s0_pipeline_archive_members_fn(archive)
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  paths <- utils::unzip(archive, files = members, exdir = output_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(paths) == length(members), all(file.exists(paths)))
  # Include the tracked ZIP for the existing exact-archive selectors in later stages.
  c(archive, paths)
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s0_pipeline_inputs_raw_chr <- s0_pipeline_archive_inputs_fn(
  s0_pipeline_raw_zip,
  here::here("data/intermediates/archive_sources")
)
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Staging Boundary"}

```sh
test -d data/inputs
test ! -L data/inputs
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-archive-source-boundary.R
```

Do not print filenames or file contents into Manual render logs. Existing
targets built from Drive inputs must be rebuilt through the compute-node
launcher before they are interpreted as products of this freeze. The baseline
checker records the archive SHA-256; changing bytes at the same path must be
reviewed as a source-freeze change.

:::
